src/state/state.odin:
package state
Store :: struct {value: int, link: ^int}
consumer/consumer.odin:
package consumer
import "../src/state"
import "../src/functions"
live: state.Store
run :: proc() {
	work: state.Store
	functions.forward(&live)
	functions.invoke(callback = functions.write, p = &live)
	functions.patch(second = &work, first = &live)
}
